name: Rule34 DW Button
description: Adds a DW download button to rule34.xxx thumbnails and post pages. Click a thumb (or anywhere on it with Easy-select on) — it goes into a persistent FIFO queue and downloads in the background. Queue survives page navigation, tab switches, and browser restarts; a TTL lock keeps multi-tab sessions from duplicating downloads. Always grabs the highest-quality original (Original image/video — never .php). Robust 429/403 retries with API fallback. Files land silently in Downloads/rule34/.
author: play3r333
